narrative.overview: Each `.md` renders as one numbered notebook page. Agents write the entries; the owner witnesses them and signs off in chat. Flat cool paper, printed form rules and labels in green-grey, one pink-red margin rule, owner inks in the margin. Dense, single page, no tabs. The brief is one progress board: slice map, steps in order, then what is not yet confirmed.
keyCharacteristics: A form header strip, then a contents column and one ruled sheet.
A margin gutter that carries every status mark.
One progress board: every task appears once, in one order.
Three owner inks that answer "who owns it".
Tally strokes and tabular figures for progress.
A condensed form face for labels and headings; system sans for reading.

rules.name: The One Margin Rule
rules.body: One 1.5px margin rule per sheet. Margin pink-red appears nowhere else except the arrival ink.

rules.name: The Owner Ink Rule
rules.body: Owner inks mark ownership only: gutter marks of open steps, the owner column, the owner line and border of the now card, lane labels, step frames. Done marks switch to form green-grey.

rules.name: The Form Label Rule
rules.body: A label names a form field or is the heading itself. Never stack a label above a heading that already names the block.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Figures stay tabular (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on body).

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: No shadows and no tinted panels. The only tints are the inline code chip (form 10%), done slice cards (form 7%), and text selection (agent 24%).

dos: **Do** keep every status mark in the gutter, left of the one margin rule.
**Do** use owner inks wherever an owner is named, and only there.
**Do** write every `unknown` in pencil and list it in Not yet confirmed.
**Do** open board blocks with a 2px form top rule; underline section openers with 1px form.
**Do** show each task once, in the progress board, in one numbered order.
**Do** keep text at AA contrast on paper in both themes.
donts: **Don't** put sections behind tabs or clicks.
**Don't** add shadows, solid-filled cards, or rounded panels.
**Don't** use margin pink-red for text, marks, or emphasis.
**Don't** use a label as a kicker above a heading.
**Don't** add a fourth owner ink; any non-Claude, non-user owner is agent.
